responseMessageContents.text:
Added a Delete Account section at the bottom of the Profile page with a two-step confirmation flow.

**Important setup needed in Supabase:** The `auth.users` row can only be deleted via a privileged function. Add this SQL to your Supabase SQL editor so the delete actually removes the auth account:

```sql
create or replace function public.delete_user()
returns void
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = public
as $$
begin
  delete from auth.users where id = auth.uid();
end;
$$;

revoke all on function public.delete_user() from public;
grant execute on function public.delete_user() to authenticated;
```

Without this RPC, the user's `user_data` row is cleared and they're signed out, but the auth account itself won't be removed — the app will show a message asking them to contact support.
